header.encoding: printable ASCII plus LF; no CR or NUL
header.elements: exactly one positive safe-integer vertex count; no other element even count zero
header.ignored: printable ASCII comment and obj_info lines, including empty payload; never resolve metadata URLs
header.terminator: standalone end_header followed by LF; exactly one format/vertex table; no unknown directives or blank lines

payload.fields: 62 IEEE754 little-endian Float32 scalars per source splat; exactly count*248 bytes; no trailing bytes
payload.finite: all scalars finite, including ignored normal; canonicalize decoded negative zero without rewriting original bytes
payload.ordering: retain every source ordinal and duplicate; no sort, merge, LOD, decimation or flattened draw index
payload.normal: finite ignored placeholders; never a surface normal
payload.budgets: byteLength<=existing maxFileBytes; count<=maxItems; 62*count<=maxValues; all safe integer arithmetic and full payload preflight before allocation/activation

frame.axis: preserve XYZ as right-handed Y-up AssetFrame coordinates
frame.unit: one source coordinate unit is prescribed as one Asset metre; no physical-unit detection, recentering or automatic registration
frame.representationToAsset: canonical identity at fresh import; later validated normalization follows specification01
frame.physicalAccuracy: coordinate convention only; not measured scale or survey accuracy

gaussian.precision: decode Float32 source to Number; binary64 semantic calculations; original Float32 bytes remain source authority
gaussian.scale: s_i=exp(scale_i); each s_i and s_i*s_i must be finite and strictly positive; reject overflow/underflow
gaussian.opacity: a=1/(1+exp(-o)) when o>=0, otherwise exp(o)/(1+exp(o)); finite sigmoid result in[0,1], without a0.99 cap
gaussian.rotation: rot_0..3 are wxyz; finite nonzero quaternion, normalize by hypot, canonical positive w or first nonzero xyz; q and -q give identical covariance
gaussian.covariance: column-vector active R(q); Sigma=R diag(s_i*s_i) transpose(R); never rotate SH by this individual Gaussian quaternion

support.region: mean+R diag(s) u with dot(u,u)<=rhoSquared; validate every scalar even for empty support

bounds.outward: each primitive axis lower=nextDown(mean_i-halfwidth_i-epsilon_i), upper=nextUp(mean_i+halfwidth_i+epsilon_i); epsilon_i=64*2^-52*max(1,abs(mean_i),halfwidth_i); binary64 nextDown/nextUp; then exact componentwise union and canonical positive zero
bounds.reject: nonfinite/intermediate bounds, nonfinite covariance, or no nonempty support; centre-only renderer boxes are not source bounds

sh.layout: DC R,G,B; f_rest_0..14 are R coefficients1..15,15..29 G,30..44 B
sh.direction: camera-to-mean; dRepresentation=normalize(inverse(L)*(meanProject-cameraProject)); L is complete Representation-to-Project linear transform; camera-at-mean has undefined direction and no transient fragment
sh.color: for each channel sum basis_k*c_k in ascending k=0..15, then add0.5, clamp the full sum to[0,1] as encoded sRGB, then use specification01 IEC sRGB-to-linear transfer; no preclamp, per-degree clamp, gamma2.2 substitute or pre-SH transfer
sh.numerics: binary64 oracle absolute/relative tolerance1e-12; this is not permission for unqualified packed/half/8bit renderer approximation

transform: mean'=L*mean+t, Sigma'=L*Sigma*transpose(L), opacity unchanged, source-direction SH as specified; positive mutable Sim3 and explicit immutable x-reflection only; compute conservative support bounds after transform, not transformed means alone

records.surfaceRange: {kind:splatSample,count:N}, no nodeIndex or primitiveIndex; global sourceSplatIndex retains every original row ordinal
records.anchorClass: one singleton visual-family class; first proxy path commits manual anchors, never splatSample evidence
